_doc: Things the player can carry (scripts/inventory.gd). id: what the story and scripts call it; name and description: shown in the satchel; icon: optional picture, a path under game/ (without one the satchel draws the initial). Give one with main.inventory.add(id) or give_item("id") in the ink.

items.name: Tally stick
items.description: A hazel stick with notches cut along one edge, split lengthwise. Someone has kept the other half.

items.name: Broken seal
items.description: Half a disc of red wax, broken clean. A tower over three wavy lines.

items.name: Strip of linen
items.description: Kitchen linen, stiff with old fat and smelling of onions. It held the bell rope out of reach.

items.name: Courier's letter
items.description: Folded, its seal already broken: a tower over three wavy lines. Addressed to the commander.
